resources.string: Everything stays on your phone – Perfsentient has no internet access.
See which apps run, for how long, and how much data they use.

Lets Perfsentient read app usage events (to spot pop-up and after-call ads), foreground-service time (apps that never stop), per-app background data (Android\'s network stats) and cache sizes. It is granted in Settings › Usage access. Perfsentient never sees what you do inside apps.
Android 13+ requires your consent before an app can post notifications. Perfsentient only sends one notification per day with your phone health score.
Count how many notifications each app posts.
Used only to count notifications per app so notification spam can be detected. Notification content (titles, messages) is never read, stored or shared.
Audit every installed app, including ones with hidden icons.
Granted at install time (QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES). Needed to find apps that hide their launcher icon, hold the \"display over other apps\" permission, accessibility services or device-admin rights.
When the end-of-day notification is sent
Setting up a phone for a child? Check its apps against their age.
Flags apps known for grooming, sextortion, contact with strangers or adult content that aren\'t right for your child\'s age, and adds a Parental help tab.
Apps on this phone are checked against this age. It is stored only on this phone.
Apps you trust are left out of your reports and don\'t lower your score.
No trusted apps yet. Tap a flagged app in your report and choose \"Trust this app\" to stop flagging it.
Heuristics based on Google Play policy, Android vitals and published adware research.
Get a notification within about 15 minutes when a risky app is installed, or an app gets access to your messages or screen. You don\'t have to wait for the daily report.
SMS Toolbox, the free messaging app from the same developer, flags scam texts on your phone. Connected, Perfsentient warns you when an app is installed right after one. Nothing leaves your phone.
The SMS Toolbox on this phone isn\'t signed by its developer, so Perfsentient ignores it. Uninstall it and get the real one.
SMS Toolbox is installed. Connect it to share the time and type of its scam warnings with Perfsentient. Never your messages or contacts.
Connected. SMS Toolbox only checks texts while it\'s your default SMS app.
Spot apps that freeze or keep crashing. Needs a one-time command from a computer.

Android only shares other apps\' freezes (ANRs) and crashes through its system error log, which requires the READ_LOGS / READ_DROPBOX_DATA permission. It cannot be granted from the phone: connect it to a computer with USB debugging enabled and run the command shown when you tap Grant. Perfsentient only reads the app name and time of each entry, never stack traces or other logs.
Enable USB debugging, connect the phone to a computer and run:
adb shell pm grant %1$s android.permission.READ_LOGS\nadb shell pm grant %1$s android.permission.READ_DROPBOX_DATA
